mechanism: Duloxetine inhibits norepinephrine reuptake, which can potentiate levodopa's sympathomimetic effects and increase risk of hypertension, tachycardia, and arrhythmias; both drugs also increase CNS serotonergic activity.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and cardiac rhythm; consider alternative antidepressant if patient requires carbidopa-levodopa; educate patient on signs of hypertensive crisis.
